speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my office. I understand you are experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise during your pregnancy. To begin, how many weeks pregnant are you, and have you noticed any rash or stiff neck?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is interesting; the ice cream consumption three days prior could suggest a foodborne illness. Given your symptoms of fever, headache, and anorexia, have you noticed any abdominal pain, diarrhea, or changes in your urine? Also, has anyone around you recently been diagnosed with a similar illness?

REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, Blood_Culture, Urinalysis
